data.Name: Sinkhole Opens
data.Description: The ground rumbles and a sinkhole suddenly opens beneath your feet!
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.15, "type": "damage_player", "text": "You stumble and fall into the sinkhole!", "params": {"damage": 15}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "damage_enemy", "text": "An enemy loses their footing and falls in!", "params": {"damage": 15, "target": "random"}}, {"probability": 0.20, "type": "draw_card", "text": "You spot something glinting in the rubble!", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}, {"probability": 0.10, "type": "draw_card", "text": "Old documents are exposed in the earth!", "params": {"card_type": "Document Card"}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "none", "text": "The sinkhole opens harmlessly nearby.", "params": {"text": "You step back just in time."}}, {"probability": 0.25, "type": "player_choice", "text": "Someone is trapped in the sinkhole!", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Rescue them", "risk": 0.3, "success": {"type": "heal_player", "amount": 10}, "failure": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 10}}, {"name": "Leave them", "effect": {"type": "none", "text": "You walk away, hearing their cries fade..."}}]}}]
